a.xlink:title: Applies widget customizations, dynamic icons and event filters.
Finds the selection-path helper attached to the tree.
Sets up marked item-view widgets and handling for children added later.
Sets up a group background and optional exclusive button grouping.
Checks whether the widget is a completer popup.
Updates an action's icon and tracks it for future theme changes.
Updates an action's icon for the selected theme.
Starts tracking the tree's selected paths.
Updates model connections and rebuilds the selected paths.
Configures a widget and its descendants for use inside an item view.
Returns the shared style, creating it when application lifetime permits.
Installs a filter to configure children added later.
Applies item-view background and sizing settings to a widget.
Disables automatic background filling and makes the Base palette brush transparent.
Loads the bundled JetBrains Mono fonts once.
Suppresses a grouped widget's background unless it declares a sunken or raised base.
Configures a widget and its descendants for a shared group background.
Makes an eligible push or tool button checkable and adds it to the supplied group.
Returns whether the widget is inside a group base.
Excludes action-managed tool buttons from automatic button grouping.
Creates a themed icon, falling back to original normal-mode pixmaps for missing resources.
Copies the normal-mode pixmaps for one icon state.
Finds a theme-specific icon resource, falling back to the default resource.
